$comment: Variant overlay (WP-M): the regular trading session. Only the clock moves; every date in the household stays anchored to the base anchor date, so golden numbers do not change. Quote and index timestamps, previous-close dates and the session follow 'now'.
description: Regular session: Tuesday of the anchor week, 11:02 ET (default 2026-11-17 11:02 ET).

patch.why: a crypto stop with no time_in_force is day-only; keep it 'placed today' on the variant's day
